answer: Make every newcomer arrive with a sponsor who has skin in it. An established agent vouches by locking part of its own balance; if the new key is later proven a sybil, the sponsor's bond burns along with it. A raven perched above the lagoon sees every boat that enters, and so does a sponsor who can lose real stake. Farms then need many honest-looking patrons, which is costly. The tradeoff: loners with no network wait longer at the horizon, so a slow unsponsored path should still exist, just with lower early rewards.
